overview: The Seru Courtyard serves as the militarized outer plaza of Sanctus Seru.
details: Loyalist soldiers enforce strict order, monitor travelers, and maintain constant surveillance. The courtyard is the first checkpoint for anyone entering the fortress-city.
hooks: A Justicar declares a temporary lockdown.
A patrol identifies suspicious magical activity.
A Katta envoy is detained for questioning.
A surveillance node malfunctions, causing alarm.
